mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCourses, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 'published' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS publishedCourses, COALESCE(SUM(assigned_count), 0) AS totalAssigned, COALESCE(SUM(completed_count), 0) AS totalCompleted, COALESCE(AVG(average_score), 0) AS averageScore FROM training_course WHERE deleted = 0
